verdict.rationale: Finix is API-first, so core workflows can be automated headlessly without the Dashboard: seller onboarding, payouts, payout links and disputes are all API-driven, and webhooks deliver programmatic notifications. Separate Sandbox credentials and a test environment make automated testing plausible, but nothing documents CI usage or a command-line tool. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless tooling, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.
